prompt: Introduce yourself to a new client team and describe your last project.

task.title: Introduce yourself and your last project
task.prompt: You join a call with a new client team. Introduce yourself, then describe your last project and the part you built.
lookFor: Your role and experience in a sentence or two
What the last project did, for whom
One result or thing you learned
task.writtenFallback: Write how you would introduce yourself and your last project to the new client team.
task.explanation: A strong answer is short and in order: who you are, what the project did, your part, one result. Simple sentences are fine; being easy to follow is what counts.

prompt: Tell your lead what you worked on today, as you would at the end of the day.

task.title: Tell your lead about your day
task.prompt: It is the end of the day. Tell your lead what you worked on, what is left, and if you need anything from them.
task.writtenFallback: Write what you would tell your lead about your day.
task.explanation: Three short parts in order: done, left, need. Plain words are best.
